digest.component_or_area: code-review gate dispatch and project criteria routing
propositions: Project code-review criteria with non-empty applies_to field are stored but never validated at load and never read during dispatch, causing them to execute on every review regardless of changed files.

The applies_to field is retrieved in effective_routing() but no code path evaluates globs against changed files for project. criterion IDs, unlike plan-review which gates project criteria via project_trigger_fires().

_activated_code_review_project_criteria() filters only on criterion_id prefix and exec type, ignoring changed_files argument and applies_to entirely, causing project criteria to bypass workflow membership gating.

applies_to lacks shape validation at overlay load, allowing malformed values (bare strings, non-lists, non-string elements) to silently narrow to empty list and revert to always-on behavior instead of failing loudly.
Empty applies_to has opposite semantics for built-in overlays (escalation-only, never glob-fires) versus project criteria (ungated, always runs), creating a semantic collision that is undocumented.
